en: A black-and-white aerial view of a small town or suburb surrounded by forest. The foreground shows open fields and a railway or road along the edge, with garden plots nearby. Beyond the fields is a neat grid of detached houses with pitched roofs and small yards, followed further back by larger, block-like institutional or residential buildings. Dense forest borders the settlement on most sides. There is no visible text on the image.
